bundledCheckout.rationale: Root causes: white-space:nowrap on customer-name, plan-title, plan-price, and CTA buttons prevented wrapping and pushed flex siblings outside the card; flex-shrink:0 on status-pill plus no min-width:0/wrap on header caused badge expulsion; fixed height:76px + overflow:hidden on plan-box vertically clipped multi-line Spanish disclosure and horizontally clipped long plan/price; plan-row space-between without flex-wrap squeezed price out; meta-grid 1fr 1fr without breakable tokens overflowed long ORD/SPEI refs; action-bar nowrap with nowrap buttons overflowed 320-360px viewports. Fixes: allow header/plan-row/action-bar to wrap (flex-wrap, align-items:flex-start), give customer-block/plan children/meta cells min-width:0 + flex bases, replace nowrap with white-space:normal + overflow-wrap:anywhere + word-break:break-word on all text slots, replace fixed height with min-height+height:auto and overflow:visible, make buttons flexible (secondary auto, primary flex:1 1 160px, max-width:100%) and stack to column + meta-grid to single column under 380px so CTAs stay 100% inside card with gap separation while preserving desktop aesthetics.
targetedFailures: es-compound-customer-name: customer/badge viewport overflow and clipping
es-disclosure-expansion-note: plan-note vertical clip by fixed-height plan-box
en-expanded-ctas-eyebrow: CTA viewport overflow and primary-CTA out-of-bounds
combined-worst-case-320: all slots + method/ref + CTA overflow on 320px

customBoardingPass.componentName: Custom Airline Boarding Pass (Outside Bundled Fixtures)
customBoardingPass.rationale: Root causes: (1) content-box sizing made 410px + 40px padding + border =452px so even baseline overflowed viewport; fixed with border-box and max-width containment. (2) white-space:nowrap on name, kicker, pill, city, PNR token and buttons prevented wrapping and forced flex items to grow past card/viewport; replaced with white-space:normal + overflow-wrap:anywhere + word-break:break-word + min-width:0. (3) header and route-strip flex children had no min-width:0 / flex-shrink allowance and header had no wrapping, so long compound name pushed pill out; added flex-wrap:wrap, passenger-meta flex:1 1 160px min-width:0, pill flex:0 1 auto with wrapping, route airport-cols flex:1 1 0 min-width:0 with seat-col flex:0 0 auto. (4) PNR token unbroken string with nowrap in space-between row overflowed; made pnr-row flex-wrap:wrap and token flex:1 1 140px with anywhere breaking and right alignment. (5) gate-advisory height:40 + overflow:hidden vertically clipped Spanish expansion; changed to min-height:40 + height:auto + overflow:visible. (6) actions flex-wrap:nowrap + min-width:145/185px forced 340px row that overflowed 320px viewports; changed to flex-wrap:wrap with buttons flex:1 1 140px min-width:0 max-width:100% so they sit side-by-side on desktop but stack/wrap cleanly on narrow screens staying inside card with gap separation.
targetedFailures: compound Latin name + gate-pill header overflow
320px CTA row overflow with fixed min-width buttons
